mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", type_id AS "typeId", type_key AS "typeKey", name AS name, description AS description, reserved_type_id AS "reservedTypeId", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.types WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY type_id

SELECT game_id AS "gameId", type_id AS "typeId", type_key AS "typeKey", name AS name, description AS description, reserved_type_id AS "reservedTypeId", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.types WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND type_id = #{typeId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.types (game_id, type_id, type_key, name, description, reserved_type_id, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{typeId}, #{typeKey}, #{name}, #{description}, #{reservedTypeId}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, type_id) DO UPDATE SET type_key = EXCLUDED.type_key, name = EXCLUDED.name, description = EXCLUDED.description, reserved_type_id = EXCLUDED.reserved_type_id, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", type_id AS "typeId", type_key AS "typeKey", name AS name, description AS description, reserved_type_id AS "reservedTypeId", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.types WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, type_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.types_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, type_id, type_key, name, description, reserved_type_id ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, type_id, type_key, name, description, reserved_type_id FROM public.types WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, type_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, type_key = EXCLUDED.type_key, name = EXCLUDED.name, description = EXCLUDED.description, reserved_type_id = EXCLUDED.reserved_type_id
